span.p:
Signals from data we already have
per call log, human decisions,
ground truth, provider canary

div.style: color: rgb(74, 13, 13) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Hard signals, no statistics needed
guardrail failures, schema failures,
provider errors, failed zero check,
spend ceiling, untiered tool, canary change
5 to 15 minutes

span.p:

nightly backtest, grounding rate
7 to 14 days
